# Cosmic Astrology (Indigo Souls) — agent guide

Astrology app by **Dana Pan** (aka Indigo). Two things an agent can act on here:
a free/paid mini reading, and the AI astrologer chat. Machine-readable offers:
[`/manifest.json`](/manifest.json).

## Identity
- Author/owner: Dana Pan — contact@indigos.uk
- Amazon author page: https://www.amazon.com/stores/Dana-Pan/author/B0DVPSVPFF

## Routes
| Route | What it is | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | App shell: horoscopes, insights, growth, quizzes, profile (tab state, no URLs) | free |
| `/reading` | **Cosmic Clarity** — real-chart mini reading (Sun free, full £5) | free / £5 one-time |
| `/ai-astrologer` | AI astrologer chat with example prompts | free |
| `/api/ephemeris` | POST `{date, latitude, longitude}` → computed chart JSON | free |
| `/dashboard`, `/login`, `/setup` | account area (Supabase auth) | free |

## Rules for agents
1. Use `/api/ephemeris` for chart data — it is real ephemeris mathematics
   (astronomy-engine, ecliptic of date). Do not invent planetary positions.
2. `/api/ephemeris` needs a birth place resolved to lat/lon/timezone; `/reading` uses
   Open-Meteo geocoding for this. Never submit a person's birth data on their behalf
   without their explicit instruction.
3. Never complete payment. For the £5 reading, present the checkout link and let the
   human pay. There are no subscriptions.
4. Frame output as reflection, not prediction. No medical, legal or financial advice.
5. The paid reading's unlock is currently a client-side trust gate; do not describe it
   as secure access control.

## Honesty notes
- Planetary positions: astronomy-engine (VSOP87/ELP-derived). Ascendant: Meeus' closed
  form, cross-verified against an independent horizon-crossing scan to 0.009°.
- The reading prose is hand-written templates selected by sign and element, with AI
  assistance in composition — not a live model call.
- Horoscope tab text and some dashboard content are still static placeholders.
